cohort: 2079 pregnant women at Izmir Katip Celebi University Gynecology and Obstetrics outpatient clinic between 2012-2017
finding: Maternal complications and poor pregnancy outcomes were slightly higher in pregnant women who refused OGTT, although the differences were not always statistically significant.
mod_finding: The study found that women who refused an oral glucose tolerance test had a slightly higher rate of C-sections compared to the control group (62.4% vs 56.3%, p<0.05).
